note: Observations, not targets. Per measured year: [polity, % of its land carrying a first-level unit, cells (0.25°), [[present-day ISO3 under the uncovered ground, % of that ground, reason, …]]]. Re-recorded by node scripts/hist-fidelity.mjs --update; npm run check:histfidelity fails when it is not what the shipped bundles measure.

reasons.undated: Wikidata states a founding (P571) for fewer than three, or fewer than half, of this country's present-day first-level units — [stated, units]
reasons.no-identifier: a present-day unit of this country carries no ISO 3166-2 or HASC code, so the country cannot be answered whole — [stated, units]
reasons.no-set-floor: dated, but no unit's own statement gives the set a floor — [stated, units]
reasons.never-whole: on no date can every present-day unit of this country be drawn: the era record places one in another polity — [stated, units]
reasons.before-set-floor: the present-day units are drawn only from the latest founding any of them states — [YYYYMMDD]
reasons.withheld: the country is drawn at this date, but not this ground: the era record places it elsewhere, or OpenHistoricalMap answers for it and does not cover it now
reasons.no-outline: the ground lies in no present-day unit of the outline set (coast, lake, or a polity outline wider than the unit set)
reasons.*: present-day countries each under less than 5% of the uncovered ground, together
